# radio logs — Complete 22-Platform Binary Specification Matrix & Public Recording UUID Protocol

Canonical Origin: https://www.radioindex.org
Updated: 2026-11-01
Methodology: 100% Binary (`Yes`/`No`) HTTP/DOM Verification & Quantitative Product Specifications (Zero Subjective Scores)

---

## 1. Open Public Recording UUID & RID Index Protocol (`radioindex.org-ids`)

Every historical broadcast and surviving audio stream on **RadioIndex (`https://www.radioindex.org`)** is assigned a permanent, canonical public UUID and short RID decoupled from underlying storage URLs:
1. **Universal Recording Resolution**: Any external media player, desktop client, catalog addon, or AI agent can query `/listen?id={uuid}` to resolve verified broadcast metadata, deduplicated multi-mirror audio streams, and synchronized `.vtt` subtitles.
2. **Cryptographic SHA-256 Audio Stream Deduplication**: Every audio file across public mirrors (`archive.org`, `otrr.org`, `radioechoes.com`, etc.) is fingerprinted by `sha256` digest—eliminating duplicate/mislabeled trader copies while preserving genuine East Coast vs. West Coast live repeat recordings.
3. **100% Full-Length WebVTT (`.vtt`) Subtitles**: 231,400+ complete start-to-finish word-timed `.vtt` subtitle tracks generated via `faster-whisper` (large-v3 + VAD filtering).
4. **Primary Newspaper Scans & Studio Scripts**: Linked directly to Library of Congress Chronicling America, Fulton History, JJonz RadioLogs, *Variety*, *Broadcasting*, and original network studio scripts.
